summary: This document defines metadata for delegating HTTPS content delivery among interconnected CDNs. It adds a CDNI Metadata interface object for delegating X.509 certificates, using the schemes of RFC 9115. The delegating party stays in full control and can revoke at any time, with no need to share private keys.
